scripts.setup: python3.14 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: venv/bin/pytest && bun run test:ts && (cd needle-harness && bun test)
scripts.typecheck-ts: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && (cd needle-harness && bun run typecheck)
scripts.coverage:py: venv/bin/coverage run -m pytest; venv/bin/coverage lcov -o coverage-python.lcov
scripts.coverage: bun run coverage:py && bun run coverage:ts && bun run coverage:rs
scripts.crap: poly-crap --coverage coverage-python.lcov --coverage coverage-ts/lcov.info $([ -f coverage-rust.lcov ] && echo "--coverage coverage-rust.lcov")
scripts.crap:changed: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=diff.mnemonicprefix GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false poly-crap --diff-base main --fail-above --coverage coverage-python.lcov --coverage coverage-ts/lcov.info $([ -f coverage-rust.lcov ] && echo "--coverage coverage-rust.lcov")
scripts.smoke: bun run smoke-mock && bun run smoke-prod
scripts.verify: bun run clean-env && bun run setup && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck-ts && bun run lint && bun run verify-integrity && bun run verify-secrets && bun run verify-deps && bun run verify-tools && bun run verify-tool-health && bun run verify-judge-self-check && bun run verify-harness
scripts.lint: venv/bin/ruff check . && venv/bin/ruff format --check . && (cd needle-harness && bun run lint)
